raw_html: [[The Warblade's Wrath]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[The Warblade's Wrath]]:''' On an [[Vorpal Strike|attack roll of 20]] which is confirmed as a critical hit this power will be released, dealing damage to the target and all enemies near it for 30d6 + 90 [[Damage#Slashing|slashing damage]]. A successful [[Reflex save]] (DC 130) reduces this by half.
